name: rich-ingest
description: Turn one transcript into typed knowledge and real tasks in a single pass: a cheap classifier picks the lenses, specialists extract in parallel, each lens persists under its own kind.

transcript.help: The raw text — a meeting transcript, a long thread, a call summary.

source_label.help: What this came from. Becomes the citation and the tag, so it is how you find everything from one session later.

metadata.why_parallel_lenses: One prompt asked to extract five different things does all five badly — it optimizes for a single coherent answer. Five prompts each with one job, one schema, and one vocabulary do not compete with each other.
metadata.writes_no_memory: Knowledge items and tasks only. Episodic and preference capture is the MEMORY subsystem's job (LEARNING-FLYWHEEL); a template that wrote both would put user-modeling in an ingest path nobody audits.

steering_examples.description: Ingest yesterday's architecture review transcript — I mainly care about the decisions and the action items.
The facts lens is pulling in boilerplate from the meeting template — drop it and keep the rest.

example_outputs: typed knowledge items and real tasks from one raw document

config.prompt:
Which extraction lenses are worth running on this transcript?

<untrusted_content source=transcript>
{{inputs.transcript | truncate(4000)}}
</untrusted_content>

When uncertain, INCLUDE a lens: the specialists below do the real filtering, and a lens that finds nothing costs one cheap call while a lens you skipped loses the content entirely.

Extract ONLY this lens from the transcript: Decisions that were MADE — not options discussed. For each: the question, the choice, the rationale, and what was explicitly rejected. A decision without its rationale is a fact that will be re-litigated.

<untrusted_content source=transcript>
{{inputs.transcript}}
</untrusted_content>

Quote or closely paraphrase the transcript. Do not add anything it does not contain, and return an empty list rather than inventing an entry to look thorough.

Extract ONLY this lens from the transcript: Reference material named or shared: documents, links, systems, specs. What it is and why it came up.

<untrusted_content source=transcript>
{{inputs.transcript}}
</untrusted_content>

Quote or closely paraphrase the transcript. Do not add anything it does not contain, and return an empty list rather than inventing an entry to look thorough.

Extract ONLY this lens from the transcript: Concrete facts and definitions stated as true: measurements, names, constraints, terminology.

<untrusted_content source=transcript>
{{inputs.transcript}}
</untrusted_content>

Quote or closely paraphrase the transcript. Do not add anything it does not contain, and return an empty list rather than inventing an entry to look thorough.

Extract ONLY this lens from the transcript: What this session was ABOUT, in a few sentences. One item, not a list.

<untrusted_content source=transcript>
{{inputs.transcript}}
</untrusted_content>

Quote or closely paraphrase the transcript. Do not add anything it does not contain, and return an empty list rather than inventing an entry to look thorough.

Extract action items someone committed to — with an owner where one was named.

<untrusted_content source=transcript>
{{inputs.transcript}}
</untrusted_content>

Only commitments, not ideas. "We should probably look at X" is not an action item; "I'll send the numbers by Friday" is.
